lure: A recruiter matched your profile to a remote job
ask: Apply and book a call on a link registered days ago

message.subject: I found what I was looking for and it led me here
message.body:
Hi [name],

I've been going through candidate profiles for a few open positions, and your marketing background stood out enough that I wanted to reach out directly rather than send a generic job post.

This role comes with real influence over campaign budgets, platform mix, and performance strategy — not just execution and reporting.

Apply here: https://calendar.adecco-hrjobs.com/invite/REDACTED

The application includes a quick step to select a time for an intro call, so that's taken care of in the same process.

Let me know if you'd like more details — happy to share.

Best,
Franz | Adecco
Adecco Recruiting Team

This email was sent to [name] via https://go.xero.com

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: This is not Adecco.
reasons: The link's domain was registered 17 days before the email.
The reply address borrows the name Adecco on another domain.
